scope.pilot_status: Parent reports pilot started separately; no pilot raw artifacts were evaluated in this review.

model.installed_size_scope: Ollama tags disk-size metadata, not RAM; registry layer sum excludes some metadata bytes.

request_settings.basis: Synthetic engineering health check; 256 cap/65536 context are not paper experimental results.
request_settings.sampling_limitation: The request overrides temperature, num_predict and num_ctx only. Other model defaults, including presence_penalty 1.5, were not explicitly overridden. Do not describe the entire decoding setup as an exact paper replication.

placement_and_context.interpretation: Ollama reported zero model VRAM and 65536 resident context during this CPU-only diagnostic. This is a reported allocation, not evidence that 65536 input tokens were processed without truncation.

performance.counter_source: Provider counters; not independently tokenized. Very short single cold-load sample, not a throughput benchmark.

allowlisted_runtime_rss_sampled_max.scope: Sum of ollama and llama-server resident sets; possible shared-page double counting; not private allocation or host memory.

visible_cgroup_memory_current_sampled_ma.scope: Entire sampled cgroup, including cache and other processes; cgroup hierarchy scope not fully established by these artifacts.

memory_sampling.memory_peak_interpretation: memory.peak was not reset: it is a cumulative cgroup high-water mark. It rose during the reviewed interval, but is not a model-only allocation or the maximum of the 2-second samples. Concurrent cgroup activity is not isolated.
memory_sampling.cgroup_limit_limitation: Both observed limits are max. Do not infer the effective LXC ancestor limits from this path; /proc reports 12 GiB memory and about 8 GiB swap, separate from UI-configured limits.
memory_sampling.swap_interpretation: Swap usage increased across the interval. No paging-rate, process attribution, or proof that swap caused the measured latency is available.

memory_sampling.oom_scope: No OOM/OOM-kill event was recorded in the sampled cgroup counters; this does not certify unobserved ancestor/host counters.
memory_sampling.quantities_not_additive: Do not add installed disk size, api/ps size, runtime RSS, cgroup memory.current and memory.peak. They measure overlapping or different scopes.

limitations: Exactly one synthetic request with 23 input tokens and 6 generated tokens; no repeated-run variance, warm-load comparison or sustained throughput measurement.
A 65536 context was requested and reported as resident, but the diagnostic did not fill that context or test history retention across four stages.
The health response tests basic JSON generation only; it provides no evidence about institutional rating accuracy, citations, allocations or strategy quality.
Two-second sampling can miss short RSS peaks; memory.peak is cumulative and broader than a model process.
Visible cgroup max values do not expose the effective ancestor allocation; /proc fields in LXC may have a virtualized scope.
Swap increase is observed but its source and performance effect are not determined.
Logical CPU count and model were observed; actual CPU utilization/thread scheduling and dedicated per-process CPU time were not measured.
Short-input token rates cannot be extrapolated reliably to the long-document pilot or used to classify a still-waiting first output as a hang.
Runtime keeps model defaults not explicitly overridden; the setup is a documented adaptation rather than an exact replication of all paper decoding settings.
Full pilot completion, observed context/history behavior, failure handling and semantic review remain separate checks; no main-readiness conclusion follows from this diagnosis.
